report.verdict: Your sales record is clear, but this customer success role asks for a different track.
write_up: Brightline is hiring for customer success, while your resume points to new-business sales. I read it for Account Executive roles: your promotion at Vantage Fleet Software and your quota and closing results give a sales recruiter a reason to move it forward.

The meeting-booking line is a good model: it names the work, the volume and who received the meetings. In your current role, the missing piece is what your quota was against and whether you can show attainment in another year.

Start with the quota and new-business lines, adding the figures and timeframes you can document. For Brightline, bring forward any real post-sale account work you haven't included; don't recast prospecting or closing as retention.

cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see you beat quota, but not what the target was or how you performed in another year. Those details give the result context for a sales role.
cards.example: Achieved 132% of quota in FY2025 against a [quota amount] target; achieved [quota attainment] in [other year]
cards.question: What was your FY2025 quota, and what attainment can you document for another year?

cards.cannot_tell: That's a useful sales figure, but the timeframe and typical deal value aren't stated. A recruiter can't tell whether this describes a quarter, a year or another period.
cards.example: Closed $1.4M in new business in [period], with a typical deal value of [deal value]
cards.question: What period does the $1.4M cover, and what was your typical deal value?

cards.line: Booked 25+ meetings per month for the account executive team
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It tells a recruiter what you delivered, how often and who it was for without making them guess.

fit.why: Your headline and current Vantage role center on full-cycle sales and new business.

fit.note: Salesforce and your work with solutions engineers on demos and pilots are relevant to a SaaS customer-facing role. If you used Salesforce for post-sale account work, describe that work in the Vantage role.
